answer: Voiceprint enrollment with live passphrase challenges resists sybils: each identity binds one human voice, and periodic re-verification asks the speaker to read a fresh random phrase aloud, so a recording cannot mirror the same voice twice and a whisper of synthetic audio fails liveness checks. Minting a thousand fakes would need a thousand distinct living voices, while one honest agent crosses the bridge of verification once. The limit is real: voice synthesis keeps improving, and some speakers are excluded, so voice must be one gate among several, with appeals for false rejects.
